_about: Neon Rail: Black Sky Run. Traffic, hazard and pickup loops are mono: the game places each in its lane and walks it toward the player. Alerts, tools and UI are stationary; music is quiet so speech stays on top. Render with python3 tools/render_sounds.py neon-rail.

sounds._arrangement: 64 beats: A; A2 with an answering lead line and a tom fill; B over D minor to E; a breakdown without drums or bass and a snare roll back in.
64 beats: A; A2 with a new handpan phrase; B over G minor to A; a pads-only close with a singing bowl.

sounds._about: Menu move: a soft console blip.
Menu select: a rising two-tone lock.
Menu open: two console blips rising, the move blip's voice.
Pause music: glassy pads and a slow pluck, the engines idling.
Workshop music: a low synth hum with a slow pulse, tools on the bench.

_score: The rail's score: bass and pad always; the beat, the lead (or, in the Black Sky event, its own lead from score/event) and a delayed arpeggio come in as stress and the route build; the acid line drives while pressure is high, and a low reese growls when the hull is low.
